'''Justin Beal'''<ref name="dt-13100">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13100 Court for the AGES], DeckTech (Justin "Bubba Joe" Beal, 22 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13100/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13100/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018071423/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13100/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Bubba Joe''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in January 2001.
